title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19
lineage: Technics RS-1506 > Grace designs Lunatec V3 (pre only) > Korg MR-1000 > DSD-DFF 1bit 5.64 Mhz > Audio Gate SW > 24/96 WAV

ai_review.summary: Fair‑sounding soundboard recording with thin low end, but an awesome 4/19/82 show highlighted by Peggy‑O and They Love Each Other.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as a “awesome” show with several fan‑favorite numbers such as Peggy‑O and They Love Each Other standing out. The SBD source is clear enough to hear vocals and Garcia’s tasty lead, but suffers from the typical early‑’82 lack of bass, making the mix sound bright and thin. Overall it’s a good concert despite the recording’s low‑end shortcomings.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is rated high (strong song choices, enthusiastic fan comments) while recording quality is only fair due to thin bass and bright mix; the weighted average yields a ~4‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear vocals and guitar, but noticeably lacking bass typical of early ’82 SBDs; overall bright and thin sound with decent clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid flow with strong folk/ballad numbers early and energetic jams later; the set feels well‑balanced despite a few thin moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's playing described as "really tasty" and generally praised throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's intro bass on certain songs is noted as well recorded, but overall the recording lacks low‑end typical for early ’82.
